_meta.description: Curated per-card deck-analysis tags (damage_role/block_role/velocity). Keyed by loc-key == runtime card.id. Mechanical stats live in card_db.json; this file holds the judgement calls (scaling vs frontload, velocity engine type).
_meta.source: Classified by Haiku subagents reading the v0.99.1 wiki card manifest (description + referenced_powers); backfilled 2026-08-07 for the v0.107.1 roster delta (+NOT_YET/+SCARE/+WITHER, -FOLLOW_THROUGH/-GRAPPLE) when card_db.json was rebuilt off the engine-pinned manifest.

ASTRAL_PULSE.note: free aoe damage to all enemies.

BANSHEES_CRY.note: high aoe damage, cost scaling with ethereal.

BLACK_HOLE.note: scaling aoe damage on energy change

BOLAS.note: free damage that bounces back to hand.

BONE_SHARDS.note: conditional damage and block from osty

BREAKTHROUGH.note: 9 damage aoe at cost of hp

BULLET_TIME.note: makes all cards free to play

CALAMITY.note: draw attacks whenever you play attacks.

CHARGE_BATTERY.note: block now plus energy next turn.

CORRUPTION.note: make skills free but exhaust them.

CRIMSON_MANTLE.note: recurring block per turn with hp cost.

CRUSH_UNDER.note: frontload aoe damage with strength debuff

DANSE_MACABRE.note: block whenever you play expensive cards.

DELAY.note: block plus next turn energy gain.

DOUBT.note: curse, applies weak when in hand

EXPECT_A_FIGHT.note: energy gain per attack in hand

FETCH.note: osty damage with draw on first play

FLECHETTES.note: damage scales with skills in hand

INFINITE_BLADES.note: add shiv each turn for scaling.

KINGLY_KICK.note: damage that costs less when drawn.

NEGATIVE_PULSE.note: block plus apply heavy doom aoe.

NEUROSURGE.note: burst draw and energy with doom

NOT_YET.note: 2-cost heal 10 hp, exhausts; no combat throughput

PALE_BLUE_DOT.note: draw next turn if 5 cards played

PHANTOM_BLADES.note: shivs gain retain and bonus damage.

PHOTON_CUT.note: damage with draw and deck manipulation

RESTLESSNESS.note: draw and energy if hand empty.

RIGHT_HAND_HAND.note: osty damage, recycled by expensive cards

SCARE.note: 0-cost aoe 1 weak, exhausts; mitigation, neither axis scales

STOMP.note: aoe damage costs less per attack.

SYNTHESIS.note: damage plus next power costs less.

UNMOVABLE.note: double first block gain per turn.

WITHER.note: status, dead card, self-damage while in hand
